informational_results.summary: Collection stops at three obsolete downstream consumers: A5 timeline_allocator imports removed GenerationSegmentTimeline; A5/A6/A7 vec_assembler imports removed multi-shot GenerationSegment. They are historical v2.x consumers, are not v3 authority, and must be migrated by their assigned A5/A6/A7 packages. Restoring aliases would violate one CinematicShot per GenerationUnit and is intentionally rejected.

root_cause_repairs: Replaced the v2.2 envelope with the v3.0 canonical payload-hashed artifact envelope and one domain schema version.
Installed the raw source -> NormalizedSource -> FactExtractionDraft -> local FactAssembler -> FactRegistry chain; model drafts cannot carry IDs, handles, hashes, ordinals, or ticks.
Made source spans immutable provenance only; source character positions are absent from time allocation and audio marker semantics.
Moved persistent fact identity to opaque local id:/fh: values, with exact registry membership lookup and deterministic duplicate normalization.
Replaced Scene-level segment semantics with v3 capability profiles, DurationIntent, per-shot GenerationUnitTimeline, local 24000-tick intervals, and a SceneTimeline that may exceed fifteen seconds.
Froze typed reference and dialogue binding intents at Shot/VisualBeat scope; removed free-text audio/reference machine fields.
Froze VEC data validation for one GenerationUnit per CinematicShot, N+1 scene boundaries, typed bidirectional reference/audio binding, and marker-only audio events without fabricated duration.
Downgraded legacy fact/checkpoint adapters to explicit read-only observations that require re-ingest/reassembly and cannot mint v3 final artifacts.
